title: Characteristics of Recycled m-Aramid and TPP Complex Solutions in Preparation and Cotton Fibers after Coating
authors: Sam Soo Kim; Ji Min Lee; Ho Hyun Cho; Kyu Yul Ryoo
sample_state: d; m-aramid/TPP 10.5/4.5 coated cotton; initial after preparatory wash
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Cotton fabric treated with recycled m-aramid/TPP complex solution; Figure 6 and section 3.2.2
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Coated cotton fabric; section 3.2.1 and Figure 5
composition: Cotton fabric coated using m-aramid/TPP source solution ratio 10.5/4.5. Section 2.4 describes grams per 100 mL solvent, while Table 2 and figure descriptions call these wt%; no conversion to retained fabric add-on.
treatment_method: Yantai Spandex meta-aramid was scoured with two water rinses at 60°C, then two ethanol and two acetone rinses at room temperature, and dried at room temperature for 24 h. For the coating solution, 10.5 g meta-aramid per 100 mL DMAc and 6 g CaCl2 were stirred at 130°C for 4 h until uniform; 4.5 g TPP per 100 mL was added. Cotton was immersed for 5 min, padded using a Mathis HVF500MM two-roll padder at 2 bar and 1.5m/min with 2Dip, coagulated in distilled water for 12 h, washed with AATCC detergent for 1 min to remove unattached material, and dried at room temperature for 24 h. Bath labels are retained as reported; coating add-on and fabric construction are unreported.
washing_state: Initial coating after prescribed water coagulation and one-minute preparatory detergent wash; no durability laundering assigned
TGA_specimen_preparation: Finished coated cotton fabric. Full program: room temperature to 600°C under nitrogen, then 600–800°C under oxygen, at 30°C/min. Retained residue at 539°C precedes the gas switch. Mass, pan, cutting/grinding, gas flow, replication and preconditioning are unreported.
source_TG_atmosphere_program: N2 from room temperature to 600°C; O2 from600 to800°C
LOI_method: Yasuda Seiki Seisakusho oxygen index instrument; test standard unreported

LOI_specimen_preparation: Finished coated cotton fabric; specimen geometry and separate conditioning unreported
source_residue_definition: Section 3.2.2 explicitly compares residual weights at 539°C: d(10.5/4.5)12.77%. Temperature is used only as the stated TG residue assessment point; the source calls539°C the control Tf, which is not admitted as a TG peak or onset.

pairing_evidence: Table 2 assigns d to10.5/4.5 m-aramid/TPP. Section 3.2.1 explicitly gives LOI 19.9 for that composition; section 3.2.2 gives its residual mass 12.77% at 539°C, with Figure 6 identifying the same coated cotton fabric series. Both are initial after prescribed preparation, before separately reported durability laundering.
limitations: Only the exact d composition is paired. The source alternates g/100mL preparation amounts and wt% solution labels; these are not treated as fabric add-on. Fabric weave, areal mass, dimensions and supplier are unreported. The article separately prepares recycled-aramid films, but the admitted result comes from the coated-cotton section and its fabric captions. The TG method switches nitrogen to oxygen at 600°C; the retained 539°C observation is within the nitrogen interval, and no separate oxygen state is created. The source captions derivative curves DTA and calls later temperatures flash points Tf; no canonical temperature metric is inferred from those terms or graph coordinates. Control 2.96% residual mass is explicitly approximate and remains held. Other source compositions either lack exact numerical LOI or matched numerical TG; the isolated k maximum LOI 21.2 has no exact matched TG residue. Repeat-washing results measure phosphorus retention and cannot supply washed TG–LOI pairs. No graph-derived replacements, retained coating mass, or extra source-specific preparation parameters are inferred.
